name: @einfach-excel/xlsx
description: XLSX import/export for einfach workbooks, as an on-demand WASM converter

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../../xlsx-wasm/dist ../rust/xlsx && node ../../scripts/strip-wasm-names.mjs dist/einfach_xlsx_bg.wasm && rm -f dist/.gitignore
